adapted.why: Target-only: this manifest, which scripts/check-bff-conformance.mjs reads.
Target-only: provider mode's window table (TDD-organization-experience-001 1.2.0), numbered apart from the pattern's migrations.
Package name @organization-experience/bff; scripts and dependency versions unchanged.

Forwards /api/v1/* to the Organization Control API's /v1/* instead of Identity Control's: option organizationControlBaseUrl, and its log line and comment. Runs the scope guard (bff/src/scope/guard.ts) before forwarding, and sets the provider window's reason and correlation (TDD-organization-experience-001 1.2.0).

Environment prefix ORGANIZATION_EXPERIENCE_*; upstream organizationControlBaseUrl from ORGANIZATION_EXPERIENCE_ORGANIZATION_CONTROL_URL; one application, so no developerWebRoot or accountWebRoot. tenantSignIn is true: the client is registered for the per-sign-in form (ADR-IAM-008). Adds the provider mode bounds ORGANIZATION_EXPERIENCE_PROVIDER_MAX_DURATION, _DEFAULT_DURATION and _STEP_UP_AGE. Adds ORGANIZATION_EXPERIENCE_IDENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORIGIN, required and an exact origin, for the acceptance page's link to identity-experience's enrolment page (TDD-organization-experience-001 1.15.0). No enrolment workload and no trusted ingress: the enrolment routes are identity-experience's, and this BFF serves none (ADR-IAM-011 §5.6).
One application at the root: applicationRoot returns '/' for every path, so routes.ts stays identical and every sign-in asks for aal2. No /developer/ or /account/ prefixes.
Target-only: GET /auth/identity-experience, identity-experience's origin for the invitation acceptance page's I do not have an account (ADR-IAM-011 §5.1, TDD-organization-experience-001 1.15.0).
Process name organization-experience-bff in its one stderr line and header comment.

Environment prefix ORGANIZATION_EXPERIENCE_* and process name organization-experience-migrate. Grants the serving role this application's own table, provider_windows, after the pattern's migrator grants the session tables.
Target-only: the BFF's own calls to the Organization Control API to open and close a provider window.
Target-only: the scope guard, what each scope reaches before a request leaves the BFF, and the two self routes every scope reaches (TDD-organization-experience-001 1.10.0).
Target-only: GET /auth/scope, POST /auth/scope/provider and /end, and the sign-out hook.
Target-only: the provider window store. Its queries name a store outage as SessionStoreUnavailable, as the session store's do, so a scope route answers 503 rather than 500.

Serves one application at / and no Developer Console or account experience; passes organizationControlBaseUrl to the proxy. Registers the scope endpoints and the sign-out hook that ends a provider window's activation, and gives the proxy the provider windows. Maps SessionStoreUnavailable to 503 in its error handler, as the source's does. Registers GET /auth/identity-experience (bff/src/links/identity-experience.ts), and no enrolment routes, which are identity-experience's (ADR-IAM-011 §5.6).
Two assertions follow the single application: a sign-in started under /developer/ lands at /?sign-in=*, and every sign-in asks for aal2.
Target-only: the scope guard and the window request, unit-tested.
Target-only: Tenant scope, provider mode and invitation acceptance against PostgreSQL and a stand-in Organization Control API.

Developer Console and account experience suites replaced by one test that their paths get this application's shell; configuration tests use the ORGANIZATION_EXPERIENCE_* names and organizationControlBaseUrl. The defaults test asserts tenantSignIn, the scope guard on, and the provider mode bounds. It also asserts the invitation acceptance page's shell carries Referrer-Policy: no-referrer (TDD-organization-experience-002 1.8.0). Configuration tests require ORGANIZATION_EXPERIENCE_IDENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORIGIN as an exact origin, and GET /auth/identity-experience answers it anonymously with no-store (TDD-organization-experience-001 1.15.0).

testConfig and startHarness set organizationControlBaseUrl and no developer or account web roots, following Config. startHarness takes Config overrides and signIn a Tenant, as identity-experience's does; testConfig carries the provider mode bounds. The scope guard is off by default, so the pattern's suites test the proxy as the pattern defines it; scope.test.ts turns it on. testConfig carries identityExperienceOrigin, and no enrolment workload or trusted ingress, following Config.
